BILL said on Thursday that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by TPG, a leading global alternative asset management firm, in partnership with Corpay for $6B.BILL will receive $63.25 per share in an all-cash transaction, representing a 31% premium to the 60-day volume-weighted average price ending on November 16.TPG will acquire a majority interest in BILL through TPG Capital, the firm’s U.S. and European private equity platform, and Corpay will acquire a minority interest.Upon the close of the transaction, BILL will become a privately held company, and its common stock will no longer be listed on any public stock exchange.BILL -3.25% to $62.00.Source: Press Release
